Boxer Terence Crawford talks with Joe Rogan about respect after his win over Errol Spence Jr. Crawford entered that fight as an unbeaten champion. Many fans saw the bout as too close to call.

Crawford says the fight took years to secure. He recalls how he controlled pace and defense once it began. Rogan praises the way he switched styles mid-fight. The pair discuss why great fights are hard to make in boxing. The episode gives fight fans a calm champion explaining, in his own words, the night that settled his place.
podcast-tuckercarlson-efBB0D4tf1Y:
Streamer Nick Fuentes sits down with Tucker Carlson for a long, tense interview. Carlson says he wants to understand what Fuentes truly believes. He asks him to state his views in his own words.

Carlson first traces how Fuentes rose to fame so young. He notes they agree on some targets, if not all views. Fuentes lays out his case without a hostile host cutting in. The episode drew wide debate for giving him that room. Listeners can hear the full exchange and judge the ideas, and the host, for themselves.
